mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_mail_send_target ( send_job_id, application_id, target_email_masked, target_name, send_result, fail_reason, sent_at ) VALUES ( #{sendJobId}, #{applicationId}, #{targetEmailMasked}, #{targetName}, #{sendResult}, #{failReason}, #{sentAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM admin_mail_send_target WHERE send_job_id = #{sendJobId} ORDER BY application_id ASC, id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT target.application_id FROM admin_mail_send_target target INNER JOIN admin_mail_send_job job ON job.id = target.send_job_id WHERE job.research_no = #{researchNo} AND job.trigger_type LIKE CONCAT(#{triggerPrefix}, '%') AND job.send_status = 'SENT' AND target.send_result = 'SENT' AND target.application_id IS NOT NULL
